testcase.name: withoutPending hides exactly the pending record, and nothing when none is pending
pending a second record displaces the first and hands it back to be committed
pending the same record again after an undo gets a new token
undo returns the pending record and empties the slot, so nothing is left to commit
undo or commit of a record that is not the pending one changes nothing
takeAny (the owner being cleared) returns the pending record and empties the slot
pend holds the record with its reference count and displaces nothing
commit (the snackbar timing out) returns the record once, and a second commit returns nothing
